# Fresh LUTs

> > Free color grading LUT library for video editors featuring cinematic presets for Rec 709, Blackmagic Film, DJI D-log, and other professional formats

Fresh LUTs provides a browser-based tool for discovering and downloading free color grading LUTs (Look-Up Tables) released under CC0 Creative Commons and other open licenses. The collection includes contributions from filmmakers and colorists worldwide, with presets optimized for various camera formats and cinematic styles.

## Key Topics

- Color grading LUTs
- Rec 709 color space
- Blackmagic Film 4K
- CC0 Creative Commons licensing
- Video editing presets
- Cinematic color correction
- DJI D-log drone footage
- Film Simplified workflow
- Gamma curves
- Blockbuster teal and orange
- Browser-based LUT tool
- Free LUT downloads
- Low-key lighting styles
- RED Log Film format
- Interview and documentary grading

## Getting Started

- [Fresh LUTs Homepage](https://freshluts.com/): Homepage for Fresh LUTs color grading tool with free LUT downloads
- [LUT Library Browser](https://freshluts.com/luts?page=6&ref=xranks): LUT library browsing page showing cinematic color grading presets

## Browse by Color Style

- [Color Collection 1](https://freshluts.com/colors/1): Color grading collection browser for film editing LUTs
- [Film Simplified Color Collection](https://freshluts.com/colors/12): Color correction LUT collection page with Film Simplified presets

## Gamma Curves & Camera Formats

- [Gamma Collection 1](https://freshluts.com/gammas/1): Gamma curve collection for cinematic film color grading
- [Drone Footage Gamma Collection](https://freshluts.com/gammas/5): Cinematic gamma LUTs for drone footage and video editing

## Popular Cinematic LUTs

- [Blackmagic BMD Film 4K](https://freshluts.com/luts/1000): Blackmagic BMD Film 4K LUT by Le Salon des Inconnus (CC0)
- [Bozen Rec 709](https://freshluts.com/luts/106): Bozen Rec 709 LUT by Mattias Horvath with high contrast blue tone
- [Cold Tone Rec 709](https://freshluts.com/luts/107): Rec 709 cold tone LUT by sagi hershkovich with blue shadows
- [SpringMorning](https://freshluts.com/luts/122): SpringMorning LUT by J. T. Semple for video editing (CC0)
- [GreenSky Arri Log C](https://freshluts.com/luts/126): GreenSky Arri Log C LUT by Remzi Bayram with warm golden highlights
- [Steel Tone Blackmagic Film](https://freshluts.com/luts/132): Steel Tone Blackmagic Film LUT with high contrast blue tone
- [Contrasty Green Blockbuster](https://freshluts.com/luts/15): Contrasty green Rec 709 LUT by Alex Jordan for blockbuster style
- [Avalanche Interview Style](https://freshluts.com/luts/172): Avalanche cool tone LUT by Cube Frames for interview style (CC0)

## Blockbuster & Teal-Orange Styles

- [Killstreak Blockbuster Teal](https://freshluts.com/luts/182): Killstreak blockbuster teal LUT by Cube Frames (CC0)
- [gLUT002 Green Shadow](https://freshluts.com/luts/184): gLUT002 Rec 709 green shadow LUT by directorgodfrey_M (CC0)
- [Serpent Teal Blockbuster](https://freshluts.com/luts/187): Serpent Blackmagic Film 4K teal blockbuster LUT by Cube Frames

## Specialized Camera Formats

- [DJI D-log Drone Footage](https://freshluts.com/luts/1943): Rec709 DJI D-log drone footage LUT by vannoeun (CC0)
- [gLUT007 RED Log Film](https://freshluts.com/luts/197): gLUT007 RED Log Film hipster brown LUT by directorgodfrey_M
